title: Review Proposal Contract
purpose: Defines the canonical repository-generic review-proposal structure and its subordinate presentation adapters.

review_fields.label: Governing issue
review_fields.description: Record the governing issue URL or issue number.

review_fields.label: Change purpose
review_fields.description: Describe the bounded purpose of this pull request.
review_fields.placeholder: Summarize the bounded purpose of the change.

review_fields.label: Accepted base revision
review_fields.description: Exact commit SHA for the accepted base.

review_fields.label: Proposed head revision
review_fields.description: Exact commit SHA for the proposed review head.

review_fields.label: Controlling specifications
review_fields.description: List the governing specifications and records.
review_fields.placeholder: repo.manifest, repo.development-workflow, and any other governing specs.

review_fields.label: Scope and exclusions
review_fields.description: Confirm scope, and list explicit exclusions.
review_fields.placeholder: Confirm in-scope work and any explicit exclusions.

review_fields.label: Patch or commit summary
review_fields.description: Provide the ordered patch or commit sequence.

review_fields.label: Specification and authority effects
review_fields.description: State any specification, projection, or authority impact.
review_fields.placeholder: Describe any specification or authority impact.

review_fields.label: Generated-artifact effects
review_fields.description: State which generated artifacts changed and whether they are current.
review_fields.placeholder: List generated artifacts and freshness status.

review_fields.label: Validation commands and results
review_fields.description: List the exact commands run and the results observed.

review_fields.label: Exact revision validated
review_fields.description: Exact commit SHA that the validation evidence covers.

review_fields.label: Known limitations or questions
review_fields.description: List unresolved questions, deviations, or limitations.
review_fields.placeholder: List any known limitations or open questions.

review_fields.label: Focused review requests
review_fields.description: Ask reviewers for the specific checks you want.
review_fields.placeholder: Call out the review focus areas.

review_fields.label: Acceptance checklist
review_fields.description: List the checklist items that must be satisfied.
review_fields.placeholder:
- [ ] Governing issue is linked
- [ ] Accepted base and head are exact SHAs
- [ ] Validation evidence names the exact head revision
- [ ] Review requests are focused
- [ ] No excluded work has been introduced
- [ ] PR body ends with the correct closure text when applicable

review_fields.label: Post-merge validation and closure
review_fields.description: Describe the required post-merge validation and the issue-closure gate.
review_fields.placeholder: Describe any post-merge validation and the issue-closure gate.

review_fields.label: Successor work not included
review_fields.description: List deferred follow-up work that this PR does not authorize.

normative_requirements.text: The repository shall define exactly one canonical review-proposal contract for bounded reviewed changes.

The canonical review-proposal contract shall include structured field definitions covering the required fields governing issue, change purpose, accepted base revision, proposed head revision, controlling specifications, summary of implemented changes, changed-path inventory, confirmation of scope and exclusions, ordered patch or commit summary, specification and authority effects, generated-artifact effects, validation commands and results, exact revision validated, known limitations, deviations, or unresolved questions, focused review requests, acceptance checklist, post-merge validation and issue-closure requirements, and successor work explicitly not included.
The canonical review-proposal contract shall require accepted base and proposed head revisions to be identified by exact commit SHA.
Validation evidence in a review proposal shall identify the exact head revision tested.
New commits shall invalidate prior exact-head validation or acceptance evidence until checks are repeated.
Passing validation shall not be treated as semantic review.
Review shall not be treated as acceptance.
Acceptance shall apply only to the exact proposed revision.
Merge shall not be treated as proof of successful post-merge validation.
The review proposal shall not use automatic issue-closing syntax when the governing issue requires post-merge validation before closure.
Empty placeholders shall not satisfy required review-proposal fields.
GitHub-specific review-proposal artifacts shall remain subordinate to the canonical repository specification.

When creating or updating a GitHub pull request, the chatbot shall load and use .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md as the PR-body template, and shall treat it as a subordinate adapter to repo.review-proposal rather than as the governing contract.
The Markdown projection shall provide a deterministic human-readable template for the canonical review-proposal structure and its structured field definitions.
The GitHub pull request template shall represent every required canonical review-proposal field.
